d: Democrat Chris Pappas has won New Hampshire’s open US Senate seat, defeating Republican John Sununu and keeping the seat in Democratic hands. In his victory speech in Manchester, Pappas called the result a “wake-up call” for corporate special interests and billionaires, accusing Washington leaders of enabling healthcare cuts, tariffs and war. He pledged to fight for a change in direction and said voters were demanding a new generation of leadership.
